methodology.evidence_rule: Existing official DiDi country-list rows establish country_supported evidence. Existing Atlas coastal/island clusters may be inherited; no new city/geography is invented from country evidence.
methodology.route_count_rule: routes_cluster_stamped counts ROUTES.properties.cluster_id. routes_touching_city/members counts stable endpoint city IDs. Both are reported because current cluster stamping is corrupted in Mexico/Galápagos and partially elsewhere.
methodology.poi_bp_rule: pois are FEATURES_BY_TYPE.poi rows by parent_city_id. route_endpoint_bps are unique from_node/to_node IDs on routes whose corresponding endpoint city matches the city/cluster. atlas-external has no LATAM files.
methodology.finance_rule: Durable counts come from finance/model/corridors.json. Recal counts are credited to a geography only when route_id resolves in current ROUTES.json; stale IDs remain unresolved rather than label-matched.

classification_rule.already_full: In current DiDi map scope and an anchor of a full market.
classification_rule.thin_to_full: In current DiDi map scope but not an anchor of a full market.
classification_rule.new_display_coverage: Existing Atlas member city in an officially supported DiDi country, absent from current DiDi scope.
classification_rule.true_registry_gap: Officially supported DiDi country has no canonical Atlas cluster; retained at country level with no invented city ID.
classification_rule.not_in_atlas: No Atlas cluster and insufficient source evidence to call a true gap.
classification_rule.exclude_inland: Exact source city is inland/non-marine; none were available in this country-only source inventory.
